@FusionLogCompression.gapFramePlacement_plan : ∀ {n r : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] [inst_1 : NeZero r] {α : Type u_1}
  [DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α) (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n α)
  (start target : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.GapFrame n r α),
  3 ≤ n →
    2 ≤ r →
      s.placed = start.decode →
        ∃ mid plan,
          mid.gap = target.gap ∧ mid.block = start.block ∧ plan.batches ≤ r - 1 ∧ plan.transfers ≤ (n - r) * (r - 1)
@FusionLogCompression.sameOrderPlacement_short : ∀ {n r : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] [inst_1 : NeZero r] {α : Type u_1}
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α) (s : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.Execution n α)
  (first second : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.NamedCyclicPlacement n r α),
  3 ≤ n →
    s.placed = first.placed →
      first.block = second.block →
        ∃ word,
          RegisteredAbsorptionChains.FusionFree F s word ∧
            RegisteredAbsorptionChains.run F s word =
                { placed := second.placed, origin := s.origin, chain := s.chain } ∧
              word.length ≤ (3 * n - r) * (r - 1) + (n - 1)
@FusionLogCompression.sameOrderPlacement_logged : ∀ {n r : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] [inst_1 : NeZero r] {α : Type u_1}
  [inst_2 : DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α) (s : FusionLogCompression.LoggedExecution n α)
  (first second : RegisteredAbsorptionChains.NamedCyclicPlacement n r α),
  3 ≤ n →
    s.state.placed = first.placed →
      first.block = second.block →
        ∃ word,
          RegisteredAbsorptionChains.FusionFree F s.state word ∧
            ((FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).state =
                have __src := s.state;
                { placed := second.placed, origin := __src.origin, chain := __src.chain }) ∧
              (FusionLogCompression.runLogged F s word).fullLog = s.fullLog ∧
                word.length ≤ (3 * n - r) * (r - 1) + (n - 1)
